scope: Encoding/source-request-proof bindings and logical byte accounting only; no live authority, approval context, retained target/history, SQL or native eligibility is supplied.
canonicalization: Recursive UTF-8 key order, compact JSON, validated array order, unescaped valid non-ASCII scalar values and standard JSON string escaping; claim u64 counters remain decimal strings.
budgetDefinition: Mandatory logical-value subtotal under the current logical row accounting: proof BLOB/key/digest, three CommitRef values, wire receipt and receipt claim reference, slot owner key assignment/result/stream/state/purpose, mutation kind/protocol and source-record reference. Evaluation ObjectRef is exact; candidate/disposition references count known assignment/full EvaluationReference, revision and digest values, omitting outer tuple/ObjectRef envelopes. Slot/key/body envelopes, complete scoped lookup key, indexes and manifest/other command effects remain excluded. No compression, ID interning or representation redesign is assumed. This is a logical lower bound, never a physical storage measurement or admission allowance.
